# Liveless Rooms golden vectors, shared by tests/liveless_rooms_protocol_test.cpp and
# tools/test_liveless_rooms_mock.py. One "name hex" per line; frames include the
# 6-byte header. Inputs: proof key 00..0F, server address "127.0.0.1",
# xuid 0009000000000001, gamertag "host", local 192.168.1.2, public 127.0.0.1,
# code ABCD2345, version "band3-test", language "eng". band3's own packets (types 0xB0
# to 0xB4, which RB3Enhanced doesn't have): features 1 (port check), port 9103, token
# 00..0F; port_check_probe is the UDP datagram, not a frame; server_info is features 3
# (port check and echo) and server version "0.3.0"; the echoes' sequence is 01020304.
